details: The "21st Century ROAD to Housing Act," which includes a provision prohibiting the Federal Reserve from issuing a U.S. central bank digital currency (CBDC) until at least 2031, has passed into law. President Trump allowed the bill to become law without his signature, solidifying the administration's stance against a federal digital dollar.
title: Housing Bill with CBDC Ban Becomes Law

details: The U.S. Department of Justice reportedly plans to drop charges against Matthew Goettsche, who was accused of being the mastermind behind the $722 million BitClub Network cryptocurrency Ponzi scheme. A "principled agreement" was reached to resolve the seven-year-long case.
title: DOJ to Drop Charges Against BitClub Ponzi Ringleader

details: Crypto exchange AscendEX has ceased operations, citing non-compliance with the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulations and mounting financial strain. The exchange cautioned users that it cannot guarantee the recovery of all digital assets and that withdrawal requests will be handled manually, potentially leading to delays.
title: AscendEX Shuts Down Operations, Warns on Withdrawals

details: The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has instructed licensed crypto trading platforms and online brokers to replace one-time passwords with more phishing-resistant authentication methods within a year. This directive aims to bolster cybersecurity and enhance protection for user assets in the region.
title: Hong Kong Mandates Stronger Crypto Platform Security

details: Stablecoin issuer Circle has received final approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to establish First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A., which will operate as Circle National Trust. This enables federally regulated custody services for Circle and its affiliates, with plans for future USDC reserve management under federal oversight.
title: Circle Receives Final Approval for US National Trust Bank

details: Federal agencies are approaching a July 18, 2026, deadline to finalize implementing rules under the GENIUS Act for stablecoin issuers. This legislation is expected to establish crucial standards for capital, reserves, liquidity, and compliance, determining the operational landscape for stablecoin issuers in the United States.
title: GENIUS Act Deadline Nears for Stablecoin Rulebook

details: Empery Digital has liquidated 1,400 Bitcoins for approximately $87.1 million. The proceeds will fund a $65 million investment in an AI data center project and repay $10 million in debt, signaling a strategic pivot away from a Bitcoin treasury strategy.
title: Empery Digital Sells Bitcoin for AI Pivot

details: JPMorgan analysts suggest that the greatest long-term threat to Bitcoin is not major sales by large holders, but rather the accelerating development and adoption of private, permissioned blockchain infrastructure by traditional financial institutions for tokenization, payments, and settlements.
title: JPMorgan Identifies Private Blockchains as Bitcoin's Biggest Risk

details: Worldcoin (WLD), co-founded by Sam Altman, will significantly reduce its daily token unlock rate by 43% starting July 24. This adjustment impacts community, team, and investor allocations, decreasing daily emissions from approximately 5.1 million WLD to 2.9 million WLD.
title: Worldcoin Cuts WLD Token Unlock Rate by 43%
